messages:
Auditor - Claire: Hi team, we're finalizing the SOC2 fieldwork scope. Need to confirm what evidence you can provide for: RBAC change history (k8s + cloud IAM), KMS key rotation trail, vulnerability triage linkage to incidents, and signed export bundles with verification steps. Also need mapping to our control IDs. Shared the audit ask: https://files.redwood.example.com/audits/fieldwork-2026-04

Sanjay (eng-security): Hi @Claire — quick clarification: for RBAC do you require every single rolebinding change or a sampled set with full pre/post snapshots? And for cloud IAM, do you want policy version history or CloudTrail ChangeRequest events?

Maria (sec-eng): We can produce both granular and sampled artifacts. Typical deliverables: 
- RBAC_diffs/: kubectl get rolebindings pre/post + audit log event id references
- IAM_history/: exported policy versions and ChangeRequest CloudTrail entries
- KMS_rotation/: rotation timeline CSV (key_id, rotation_ts, rotation_version) + CloudTrail GenerateDataKey/Decrypt events
- VULN_TRIAGE/: vuln_id -> jira_ticket -> deploy_ts -> incident_link mapping CSV
- SA_DEPROV/: service-account deprovision proofs (actor, timestamp, PR link, pipeline run)
We sign the bundle with our internal GPG key and publish a sha256 manifest. For example: ```./ops/export-audit --bundle=soc2-2026-Q2 --include=rbaс,kms,iam,vulns --sign --out=/tmp/soc2-2026-Q2.tar.gz```

Sanjay (eng-security): We'll include PR commits and CI artifacts that led to RBAC changes, so you can trace who approved the change. Retention: default is 1 year; we can keep 3 years on request. What retention window do you need?

Auditor - Claire: Minimum 90 days acceptable; 1 year preferred. For acceptance criteria: manifest.json (signed), sha256 sums, mapping file that ties each file to control IDs (e.g., CC6, CC7). Also require UTC-normalized timestamps and an envelope row for KMS that includes key_id, rotation_version, and policy_hash.

Maria (sec-eng): Affirmative. We'll include an envelope header in the KMS CSV: "key_id","rotation_version","policy_sha256". All timestamps RFC3339 UTC. We'll add a README with verification steps (verify GPG signature, verify sha256 sums, how to replay CloudTrail events).

Tyler (infra): I'll schedule the export job and attach oncall trace. @export-bot start job

export-bot: Export job accepted: job_id=exp-2026-04-18-812, started=2026-04-18T08:45:07Z, target=s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2-2026/exp-812. Progress updates will be posted to this thread.

Sanjay (eng-security): For vuln triage linkage — we'll produce a timeline per vuln: vuln_id, discovery_ts, triage_owner, vulnerability_severity, fix_pr, deploy_ts, incident_id (nullable). That should satisfy crosswalk and evidence linkage.

Auditor - Claire: Great. Two more items: 1) For service accounts that were deprivileged, we need the deprov PR, the actor, timestamp, and the pipeline run log showing the successful removal. 2) Can you include a snapshot of role-to-principal mappings (CSV) for the pre-change and post-change state for sampled items?

Maria (sec-eng): Yes to both. We'll include SA_DEPROV rows with PR link + pipeline URL and a small sample of role-to-principal CSV snapshots in RBAC_diffs/. We'll pick a representative sample across clusters/services.

Tyler (infra): ETA: initial sample bundle uploaded within ~18 hours. We'll post presigned URL and job manifest here when done.

Auditor - Claire: Thank you. Please ensure the manifest includes envelope metadata for KMS keys and that all entries are UTC. I'll review and aim to respond within 48 hours of receiving the bundle. :+1:

Maria (sec-eng): Understood — we'll follow up with the signed presigned link. Posting checklist here: 1) include control mapping CSV 2) include README verification steps 3) include signed-manifest.sha256 4) timestamp normalization 5) include PR/commit SHAs for traceability

Sanjay (eng-security): Noted. Adding retention note in README: default 1y, extendable to 3y on request.

export-bot: job_id=exp-2026-04-18-812 update: bundle creation complete. Uploaded to s3://redwood-audit-exports/soc2-2026/exp-812/soc2-sample-bundle.tar.gz. Signed manifest: soc2-sample-bundle.manifest.sig. Next: generating presigned link (valid 7 days).

Tyler (infra): Presigned URL: https://s3-presigned.redwood.example.com/soc2-2026/exp-812/soc2-sample-bundle.tar.gz?X-Amz-Expires=604800 (will PM creds). Reply here once you've downloaded, @Auditor - Claire.

Auditor - Claire: Downloaded and verified signature. Initial pass looks good. I may have a few follow-ups after deep review. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Maria (sec-eng): Thanks — standing by for follow-ups. We'll prepare the extended retention export if requested.

Sanjay (eng-security): Thanks everyone. Closing loop once Claire posts any items.
